content.short: Hydro Protocol is the primary liquid staking and LSDFi infrastructure on Injective, optimizing yield efficiency.
content.description:
Hydro Protocol is the definitive Liquid Staking Derivatives (LSD) and LSDFi infrastructure built on the Injective Network. By allowing users to stake INJ and receive hINJ (liquid INJ), the protocol enables participants to earn staking rewards while maintaining capital liquidity for use across other DeFi applications in the Injective ecosystem. 

Beyond basic liquid staking, Hydro features innovative products like Real Yield Assets (RYA), which provide diversified yield sources through indexed baskets. The platform also offers auto-compounding vaults and farming opportunities, serving as a core liquidity engine that standardizes asset management and expands utility for the broader Web3 community.
content.meta: Hydro Protocol is the leading LSD and LSDFi platform on Injective, offering liquid staking, auto-compounding, and yield-bearing assets.
